dishes.name: Tarbais bean stew
dishes.desc: Creamy white beans grown around Tarbes under a protected label, cooked with pork or confit. Introduced in the 18th century, they are the pride of the Hautes-Pyrénées.

dishes.name: Garbure
dishes.desc: Thick Pyrenean soup of cabbage, beans, potatoes and preserved meat, eaten as a winter meal. A staple of mountain farm kitchens in Bigorre and Béarn.

dishes.name: Black pork of Bigorre
dishes.desc: Ham, sausage and chops from an old black pig breed raised in the Pyrenean foothills, with its own protected label. Found at Tarbes market and local restaurants.

dishes.name: Gâteau à la broche
dishes.desc: Tall ring-shaped cake baked on a spit, layer by layer, giving it a rough, branched crust. A traditional Pyrenean celebration cake of the Hautes-Pyrénées.
